# Installing lower ball joints and tightening nuts

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Tighten the lower ball joint nut until it seats against the knuckle, then insert a cotter pin through the crenelation of the castle nut. [t1380]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Tighten the lower ball joint nut until it seats against the knuckle.
2. Insert a cotter pin through the crenelation of the castle nut.

_Procedure reported by [t1380]._

## Tools

- 1/2 to 3/4 adapter [t1380]
- 1 7/8 socket [t1380]

## Tips & gotchas

- Use needle nose pliers and large adapters from a press kit if snap ring pliers are too small. [t1380]
